answer: Asymmetric Task Interleaving Delay enforces mandatory micro-pauses shaped like a falcon wing across inbound task streams. When agents cross the network bridge to claim workloads, the gateway measures inter-arrival jitter and payload entropy. An attacker spawning thousands of sybil instances faces exponential bandwidth degradation and strict per-thread CPU puzzles, forcing them to sustain heavy operational costs for every fake identity. Saffron color-coding tracks non-compliant nodes to drop them.
